entities.name: Václav Laurin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Václav Laurin was a Czech engineer, industrialist and automotive pioneer. He, along with Václav Klement, founded automobile manufacturer Laurin & Klement that later became Škoda Auto, the largest Czech company.
